question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
seller_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT do2.customer_id) AS distinct_customers
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    JOIN delivered_orders do2 ON oi.order_id = do2.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price - oi.freight_value) AS total_profit
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    JOIN delivered_orders do2 ON oi.order_id = do2.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS distinct_orders
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    JOIN delivered_orders do2 ON oi.order_id = do2.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_five_star AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) AS five_star_count
    FROM olist_order_reviews r
    JOIN delivered_orders do2 ON r.order_id = do2.order_id
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE r.review_score = 5
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
)
SELECT 'Highest number of distinct customers' AS achievement, 
       (SELECT seller_id FROM seller_customer_counts ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC LIMIT 1) AS seller_id,
       (SELECT distinct_customers FROM seller_customer_counts ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC LIMIT 1) AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest profit (price - freight_value)',
       (SELECT seller_id FROM seller_profit ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1),
       ROUND((SELECT total_profit FROM seller_profit ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1), 2)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest number of distinct orders',
       (SELECT seller_id FROM seller_order_counts ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC LIMIT 1),
       (SELECT distinct_orders FROM seller_order_counts ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Most 5-star ratings',
       (SELECT seller_id FROM seller_five_star ORDER BY five_star_count DESC LIMIT 1),
       (SELECT five_star_count FROM seller_five_star ORDER BY five_star_count DESC LIMIT 1);
